_about: Demo content for the Pixie Dust Floral Design concept site. Each table mirrors a future Airtable base and uses the same shape as the Airtable REST API ({ records: [{ id, createdTime, fields }] }), so a Netlify function can return live Airtable data in this exact format later without changing script.js. Image attachments use Airtable's attachment shape ({ url, filename, width, height }). This file is the only data source for the demo: no Airtable API key or live connection is used.

fields.Quote: I trusted Tiffany with our floral arrangements and design for our special day… When I walked into our ceremony and saw the MAGIC she made come to life, I was truly speechless!
